question: What does a follower get from the structured calls of @alastartrader1 when each is executed as written from its first public receipt?

evidence: 2026-10-22 review: the official Alastar profile's DM is @alastartrader (no 1); this channel sells VIP/PREMIUM access and 'recovery' deposit plans through @Albanwatts
posts 2049/2059 (deposit $500 earn $6,800), 2056 (VIP price list), 2060 ('$10K to $1M challenge, DM me')
post 2064 (BEAMX LONG 50x, entry 0.004040) went out in the same second as post 2066 ('BEAMX TP3 HIT +201%'); price was 0.00463, above every target, and TP3 had traded at 06:50 UTC

receipt.archive: the news collector's first live receipt of the public preview https://t.me/s/alastartrader1 (data/research/telegram_observation/alastartrader1)
receipt.collector_exclusions: any first-receipt exclusion other than a visible edit (late first observation, truncated text, media only) excludes the post
receipt.clock: a Binance server-time reading (3 reads, minimum round trip, |offset| <= 2 s, round trip <= 10 s) taken within 10 minutes of the receipt; refreshed every 5 minutes

signal.rules_module: core/research/kol_bracket_engine.py (frozen hub-v1 bracket rules, imported unchanged)
signal.call: LONG or SHORT (exactly one) in the first three lines, a symbol, and a TP line
signal.not_signals: recaps ('TP3 HIT'), analyses without a side in the header, promotions, media-only posts

universe: Binance USD-M USDT perpetual with status TRADING (1000x prefixes resolved) in the newest exchangeInfo snapshot, refreshed every 6 hours; a failed refresh keeps the previous snapshot for up to 7 days

execution.activation: next official 1-minute open after the freeze
execution.entries: written limit legs; a leg already through the market fills at the activation open; a market entry fills at the activation open
execution.cancel: unfilled legs are cancelled when TP1 or the stop trades first, after TP1, or after 72 hours
execution.targets: every written target an equal slice of the filled size
execution.bars: 1-minute for two hours, then 5-minute with 1-minute replay of ambiguous bars
execution.leverage: unlevered for the main result; the written leverage's isolated liquidation path is recorded alongside
execution.funding: actual settlements from the latest-N public fundingRate query; unproven coverage is recorded as unavailable

control: 45 days after entry: the same relative bracket on the same coin on 1h bars at 58 starts every 12 hours over days 1-30 after entry (and 30 days before), price only at 20 bps; excess = signal on 1h minus the post mean

sample.role: descriptive monitoring of an impersonator channel; no pass rule, never a strategy to trade
